title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
S&P 500 +1.79% (24h) → 7,737 — Aug 5 record close driven by Hormuz optimism and tech earnings.
Oil -4.87% (24h) → $81.96 — continued decline as Strait of Hormuz deal progress weighs on crude.
Gold +4.13% (24h) → $4,245 — safe-haven demand sustained; second consecutive session above threshold.
DeFi sector -38.7% (24h), Fear & Greed 25 (Extreme Fear) — sharp altcoin risk-off; BTC holds $64,926 (+0.9%) with dominance at 56.6%.
NFP due Fri 7 Aug 08:30 ET: consensus 80–88k (prior 57k) — pivotal for Fed rate path; no cuts in 2026, rate at 3.50–3.75%.
